author: Phil Owen
description:
Ever since Fortnite started publicly posting player numbers back in 2023, the doomsayers have come out in full force any time there's a decline in concurrent or average player numbers. We're in exactly one of those situations right now, as player counts for the game's main mode, Battle Royale, have fallen significantly since Chapter 7 Season 4 started on August 14. After the summer season saw a big bump in engagement, thanks to some combination of the sprite-focused gameplay and the nearly entirely new map that Epic dropped at the start of Season 3, player counts have been heading back towards the sort of numbers we saw in Season 1 and 2. In other words: Not great, Bob!

According to fortnite.gg, which collates players numbers from the Fortnite API, the average number of players in BR is down 37% in September from Au
title: Why Are Fortnite’s Player Numbers Falling So Hard This Season?

author: Blair Marnell
description:
Are you planning to disappear into Vice City when Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives in just over two months? You’re not alone and doing so definitely isn't uncommon. For decades, fans have been calling in sick or taking vacation time when a new game in a series they love drops. For franchises like Call of Duty, which receives new titles on an annual basis, this theoretically adds up to a lot of time off. GTA games, however, are so infrequent that it’s almost become a generational event for one to arrive. It’s only natural that some players don’t want to wait any longer than necessary to experience it.

AAA games are more than just singular luxury purchases. They’re an investment of time that the vast majority of people can’t easily make without cutting into their normal lives. That’s why a growing number of gamers have figured out that one of the best ways to fully experience a title like GTA 6 is to make sure you’ve already c
title: Go Ahead And Take Vacation Time To Play GTA 6

author: Jade King
description:
Nintendo has finally revealed its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake with a lengthy gameplay demonstration and luscious release date trailer. This long-awaited revival of the seminal masterpiece looks incredible, and is poised to be a very faithful take on Link’s first 3D adventure. 

But this dedication doesn’t mean that Nintendo isn’t introducing a bunch of new features to the game or updating aspects of the experience so it looks and plays better than ever. Here are eight major changes coming to the Ocarina of Time remake and why they might impact how the game looks, plays, and departs from the 1998 masterpiece.
title: 8 Big Changes That Prove The Ocarina Of Time Remake Is More Than A Link To The Past

author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
Spoiler season has officially begun for Reality Fracture, Magic: The Gathering's upcoming multiversal set that serves as the culmination of the TCG's three-year story arc. Set in an alternate universe (referred to as the Echoverse) in which Planeswalker Jace Beleren has oh-so-generously taken it upon himself to "fix" everything he finds wrong with the world, Reality Fracture depicts his hostile, perfectly curated world and the other Planeswalkers of Lorwyn's efforts to demolish it.

Ahead of the set's official release on October 2, Wizard of the Coast offered GameSpot an exclusive look at three cards: Surveillance Phantasm, Silence the Echo, and Chandra's Emberling. Each of these cards depicts a moment from
title: Magic The Gathering’s Jace Has Turned Into A Flock Camera In This New Card

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
As the studio behind one of the most highly anticipated games of all time, GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games has divulged more details on how it keeps its secrets. As part of a hearing, which began yesterday at the Glasgow Employment Tribunal--in which Rockstar Games has been accused of unlawfully firing 34 GTA 6 developers based in the UK and Canada last year--the studio compared keeping a lid on GTA 6 to be on the same level as Apple or the Coca-Cola Company protecting its trade secrets.

"Guarding the secrets of the unique gameplay and design are akin to Apple protecting the iPhone or Coke protecting its formula," Rockstar said in its opening note (via
title: GTA 6 Developer Is Fighting Drones And Hackers To Keep The Game’s Secrets Safe

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
EA has officially been sold, and with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund now the majority shareholder in the video game company, talks are reportedly underway to merge it with Savvy Games Group, the gaming and esports holding company that's also owned by the PIF.

Speaking to Bloomberg, sources said the PIF is aiming to foster "better coordination" between its gaming assets, and the merger could happen once it completes its plan to acquire Chinese mobile gaming company Moonton, a deal valued at $6 billion. The PIF also owns Pokemon Go developer Scopely and game publisher SNK, and it holds sizable stakes in video game publishers like Nintendo, Capcom, and Koei Tecmo.  

The move could face scrutiny from
title: EA’s New Owners May Be Considering An Even Bigger Gaming Empire

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Wardogs, perhaps as a consequence of its immense popularity, has had quite the rocky launch into early access on Steam. On September 10, players were in hours-long queues attempting to get online, and the issues have only persisted since then. Now, while many are able to access the game and play, some are plagued by an error code that begins with WD-L014. This prevents the game from getting past the launcher at all.

There are a few ways to fix this, and although they're not guaranteed to work, we're assured by the Wardogs development team that they're looking into it on a technical level and it should be resolved soon. As soon as we have an official update on that, we'll update this guide.
title: How To Fix The Wardogs WD-L014 Error Code

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Everyone is focused on VRR (variable refresh rate) support for Switch 2 while docked. But the latest system update just provided a notable quality-of-life improvement for people--especially families--who own multiple Switch 2 and Switch consoles. Nintendo now allows for you to play a virtual game card on one of your devices without both having to be online. Previously, you'd need both hybrid consoles connected to the internet if you tried to play a digital title while it was "stored" on another.

For example, say your child is playing Super Mario Bros. Wonder on
title: Switch 2 Update Secretly Makes Digital Game Sharing Much Better

author: Kenneth Seward Jr.
description:
PAX West showcased a ton of awesome games this year. And while most were revealed ahead of the convention, with several major publishers making their presence known, the main draw for me was the indie scene. Whether it featured charming visuals, an engaging story, or some unique spin on old mechanics, nearly every indie game I played earned a slot on my ever-growing Steam wishlist.

There were six games in particular that proved to be more exciting than the rest. Below, I go into detail about those six and why they're all worth adding to your Steam wishlist. These are upcoming games that are not in an alpha or beta state--it would be unfair to judge games that could still fundamentally change against games that are already rapidly approaching a launch date.
title: 6 Exciting Indie Games That Should Be On Your Wishlist

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Wardogs launched into early access on September 10, and to celebrate, a Twitch Drops campaign is running with various rewards. By watching streams for a certain length of time, you can earn rewards to take to the battlefield with you. Here's all you need to know about how to earn Twitch Drops, and how to link your Wardogs account so you'll see them in-game.

Wardogs Beta and Launc
title: Wardogs Twitch Drops: All Rewards And How To Get Them

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
If you're struggling to deploy your parachute in Wardogs, there could be a few reasons. Firstly, you'll need to actually own one, and secondly, there has been a bug that unbinds the parachute control without having a reliable way to rebind it. We've got all you need to know on how to fix both of those issues, so fear not, you'll soon be sailing to a safe landing.

Firstly, you'll need to buy a parachute. To do this, head to an equipment vendor. Head to the gear tab and buy a parachute. The basic one is cheaper but cannot be manually controlled, so it's worth grinding to level 35 and saving up the $500 to get the Sport Parachute. You can use the basic one to begin with in a pinch, but when you fall, you'll be an easy target for enemies since you can't move.
title: Try These Steps If Your Parachute Isn’t Working In Wardogs

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
With Sony no longer involved in the production of Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor, Physint, people are wondering why the PlayStation company decided to part ways with the veteran game designer's upcoming game. Xbox has stepped in to rescue the project, resulting in a rare win for Sony's rival. At the same time, Sony is weathering a PR storm brought on by its decision to kill game discs, rising console prices, and more.

Why would it take another loss in the court of public opinion? Reportedly, Kojim
title: Death Stranding Franchise Likely Barely Broke Even, Could Explain Sony Dropping Physint – Analyst

author: Callum Self
description:
I pride myself on spotting upcoming games I’ll enjoy. I’ve had plenty of family and friends ask me what titles they should potentially buy in the near future. However, as far as I know, I had zero knowledge of Wardogs before its early access release. With the FPS game suddenly blowing up on Steam and reaching the #4 spot on the Steam concurrent charts on launch day, you can guarantee I wasn’t just making a surprised Pikachu face; I was intrigued. Now, if you want to jump into the latest hit, Fanatical has it at an excellent discount, beating out the listed price on Steam.

Like many, I’m twiddling my thumbs and waiting for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and, of course, a small little game called Grand Theft Auto VI. Sure, plenty is coming up, but
title: New FPS Wardogs Is Dominating Steam Charts, And You Could Get It At A Discount Already

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Flying a helicopter in Wardogs is a little trickier than you might expect. You'll have to balance altitude and realistic controls to avoid killing anyone in your helicopter in a blazing wreckage. However, there are ways you can practice before heading into a match, and we've got some tips on how best to control your aircraft.

How to practice flying a helicopter

You can practice flying in Wardogs in the firing range. To access it, look at the bottom left area of your menu. When you've entered the firing range, head to the left to seek out the Vehicle Vendor. This will spawn in any vehicle in the game for free, so head to the "Air" tab and select the aircraft of your choice. Once the helicopter has spawned in, make sure you're on the driver's side, jump i
title: How To Fly In Wardogs

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Logan is sporting a sharp look in Marvel's Wolverine, and if you're a fan of his latest video game incarnation's fashion sense, you can bring him home with this sixth-scale figure. Hot Toys has revealed its official Wolverine figure, which features Logan in his default black-and-yellow "Battle Reborn" battlesuit. As you'd expect, it's not going to be cheap, but you are getting plenty of extras with this figure.

You'll have two options: either a $285 standard figure or a $375 de
title: Hot Toys’ Marvel’s Wolverine Figure Gets The Details Right, Right Down To The Hairy Silicone Arms

description:
It feels like it's the 2021 PS5/Xbox Series X|S shortage all over again, as scalpers have once again begun targeting preorders for limited-edition consoles and accessories. title: GTA 6 DualSense Controller Scalpers Are Already Cashing In

author: S.E. Doster
description:
The final season of Black Ops 7 arrives on September 17, and Activision has detailed the four new weapons you can earn. Season 6 adds the TR51 Para assault rifle, VMP submachine gun, a melee weapon, and a powerful new gun in the special weapon category. In this guide, we'll detail all of the new Season 6 weapons and how you can unlock them for free.

As for new content, Season 6 of Black Ops 7 and Warzone is themed around Call of Duty's annual The Haunting event. There is a brand-new battle pass packed with Halloween-themed operator skins and weapon blueprints. More maps and modes arrive to multiplayer and Zombies this season, while Warzone gets a spooky nighttime variant of the Haven's Hollow Resurgence map. Additionally, the season also includes a
title: How To Unlock All Season 6 Weapons In Black Ops 7 And Warzone

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Take-Two owns one of the largest entertainment franchises out there in Grand Theft Auto. The newest entry, GTA 6, launches this November. There is enormous hype for the new game, which is expected to sell millions of copies at launch and break records. In short, it's expected to be a once-in-a-decade (if not ever) kind of title. The game is also coming to market with a lot of positive sentiment and excitement. If you're a Take-Two shareholder, however, the past year has been a big bummer. Take-Two's share price has slid about 15% so far this year and is down about the same over the past year, meaning anyone who invested in the past year has lost money (at least on paper; gains or losses are not realized until positions are sold) in the run-up to GTA 6's release in November. 

What's going on here? There are plenty of factors involved in what could be driving Take-Two's stock price down, and plenty of reasons that t
title: GTA 6 Is Going To Be Huge. So Why Is Take-Two’s Stock Having Such A Bad Year?
